description: Creates a sealed bounty, with a predicate helper ("the USDC balance of the target contract drops by at least minDrop" → ERC20_DROP clause), tiers, fees read on-chain, createBounty parameters and an EIP-3009 authorization. PREPARES only: signs and sends nothing, returns the data the user signs in their wallet.

from.description: the protocol's wallet, which funds and signs

funding.description: initial funding in USDC (default: one payment of the highest tier, fees included)

minDrop.description: minimum drop that proves the exploit, in USDC

productId.description: the Sealed Bounty product (default: the open level's); arc_bounties names the products of each level

protocolX25519.description: the protocol's PUBLIC X25519 key (never the private one)

reward.description: the hunter's reward in USDC (one tier)

tiers.description: several tiers [{ minLoss, amount }] in USDC

name: arc_bounty_prepare_create
